name: Villainess Idolized By Everyone: Closed Hearts Explore Compassion & Kindness
source:
~ Welcome to 7 Colors of Love ~

Eyes on her phone in the middle of the road, our heroine is hit by a truck and reincarnates into the game she had the misfortune of playing at that moment. 

Now she's a villain of an otome, and she has to avoid a terrible fate!..

Or does she? Is the voice from the sky going to be of any help?

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/vibe-check]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
~ 欢迎来到爱的七种颜色 ~

我们的女主角在路中间盯着手机，被卡车撞了，转世到了她当时不幸玩的游戏中。

现在她是乙女反派，她必须避免可怕的命运！..

或者她是吗？从天而降的声音会有帮助吗？

[来自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/vibe-check]Itch.io[/url]]
